title: POV: first week on night shift and no idea what you'll actually take home
description:
first week of nights and nobody really explains the pay. night differential, overtime, what comes off for tax... you just hope the first check looks right.

we built ShiftPayday's calculator for this. put in your rate, your hours and your night hours and it shows your take-home with the full breakdown, line by line, before payday.

the calculator is free, no account needed. it's an estimate from the rates you enter, not tax advice.

#nightshift #nurse #newnurse #paycheck #shiftwork
